fields.label: Digest

fields.description: Email addresses, one per line or comma-separated.
fields.label: Recipients

fields.description: Receives a generic JSON body ({text, incident}). Use the Slack or Mattermost types for their native formats.
fields.label: Webhook URL

fields.description: Raven Channel ID (name of the Raven Channel document).
fields.label: Raven Channel
Incoming Webhook URL
fields.description: Slack: app → Incoming Webhooks. Mattermost: Integrations → Incoming Webhooks. Stored encrypted: the URL is the credential.

fields.label: Room ID
fields.description: Internal room ID such as !abcdef:example.org (Room settings → Advanced). The bot account must have joined the room.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: Access token of the bot account that posts the alerts.

fields.label: Topic
fields.description: On a public server anyone who knows the topic can read it: pick an unguessable name or protect it with an access token.

fields.label: ntfy Access Token
fields.description: Optional access token (tk_…) for protected topics.

fields.label: Application Token
fields.description: Token of a Gotify application (Apps → Create application).

fields.label: Phone Numbers
fields.description: One per line or comma-separated, in the format your gateway expects (usually +33612345678).

fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.description: Template with {to}, {text} and {secret}, e.g. https://sms.example.com/send?to={to}&msg={text}. Values are URL-encoded.

fields.label: Body Template
fields.description: Optional, with {to}, {text} and {secret}, e.g. {"to": "{to}", "message": "{text}"}. Empty: to=…&text=… (form) or {"to": …, "text": …} (json).

fields.label: Auth Header
fields.description: Optional header line, e.g. Authorization: Bearer {secret} or X-API-Key: {secret}.

fields.label: Secret
fields.description: API key or password, inserted where {secret} appears. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Max Length
fields.description: 160: one SMS. 320: up to two concatenated SMS (306 characters). Text that needs Unicode (e.g. emoji) fits 70 / 134.

fields.label: Routing Key
fields.description: Integration key of an Events API v2 integration.

fields.label: Events API URL
fields.description: Change it for the EU service region or an Events v2 compatible receiver (Grafana OnCall, Opsgenie …).
